stock_comparison_limits.reason: Stock NT TRE is protected; no protected level/geometry decoding or quantitative renderer comparison attempted. IMG file sizes or GMP size are not equivalent rendering-cost measurements.
stock_comparison_limits.header_raw_field_warning: The generic 188-byte mkgmap TRE layout labels display_priority u24. Global base-map longitude sentinel wrapping is not normalized; no base-area density calculated.

minimal_physical_AB.action: Record whether symptom is actual road movement, simulated navigation, or manual pan, the displayed zoom scale, map view, detail, location and approximate seconds to complete redraw. Confirm positions/routes for 6 and150 separately from search.
minimal_physical_AB.purpose: Avoid conflating address-query acceptance with redraw or route/position acceptance.

minimal_physical_AB.action: At a stationary location pan the same short scene near the same address/zoom/view/detail; compare AP supplement + Search v2 with AP supplement + stock CN road (Search v2 off). Reboot between combinations, keep AP enabled. Time first cold pan then repeat the same pan after tiles are warm.
minimal_physical_AB.purpose: Change only road source; both groups use same new AP. Cold/warm difference can suggest loading/cache contribution but is not direct storage-performance proof.
minimal_physical_AB.interpretation: OSM-only slow suggests map/style or OSM compatibility contribution. Both slow suggests common device/settings/base behavior. Neither case alone proves CPU insufficient.

minimal_physical_AB.action: Restore AP + Search v2, same scene and zoom. Change only 地圖詳細度 to 簡略, then restore original setting.
